table_title: List the top 3 most populous cities per continent with country, population, population basis, and reference year.
db_analog: SELECT continent, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY continent ORDER BY population DESC) AS rank, city, country, population, population_basis, year FROM source_defined_continent_city_rankings QUALIFY rank <= 10 ORDER BY continent, rank
temporal_note: Wikipedia per-continent city-ranking master articles, accessed 2026-04-30. Each continent's source page applies its own population convention and ranking rule, and the staged instance commits to those source-defined conventions rather than imposing a single global rule. Africa: 'List of cities in Africa by population' ranks by urban-population estimate (Cairo at 23.2M is the urban-population figure, not city-proper 9.8M); all 10 entries cite a 2026 World Population Review estimate. Asia: 'List of cities in Asia by population' is a multi-population table; the staged Population column is the City proper sub-column, and the Year column carries the source's parenthetical year qualifier when present (5 of 10 Asia rows carry a year, 5 do not). Europe: 'List of European cities by population within city limits' is strictly city-proper / official municipal population. North America and South America: same Wikipedia convention (city proper). Oceania: 'List of cities in Oceania by population' ranks by Urban area population (Significant Urban Area for Australian entries) rather than city proper; this is the only convention the source page provides. Population numbers update annually as new estimates are published; this instance is a 2026-04-30 snapshot. Antarctica is excluded because it has no permanent cities. Istanbul appears once on Asia's list (Rank 8, city-proper 14.66M, no year qualifier on source page) and once on Europe's list (Rank 1, official 2025 estimate 15.75M); both are kept because each continent's source page lists Istanbul independently with its own population value.
_extraction_notes: Derived from top_10_most_populous_cities_per_continent by deterministic filter/projection on the parent CSV. Rank <= 3.
